videos.title: W46 Yes or No #2: Should I keep giving myself space before I answer?
videos.review_summary: 【審閱用】W46 Yes or No #2「Should I keep giving myself space before I answer?」：01 夜空版 9 秒循環，YES=patience／NO=clarity after the clouds clear，IG 留言關鍵字 SPACE，TikTok 導 IG。

platforms.label: Instagram
platforms.caption:
Some messages sit unread because answering right away would mean performing a calm you don't have yet. Taking space can be a kind thing to do for yourself and the other person, as long as it has an end.
Pause the Reel. Wherever it stops is today's answer.
Whichever you land on, here's something to do today: set a timer for 90 minutes and do one offline thing, like a walk, a shower, or making food. When the timer goes off, answer in three lines or less, or decide when you will and put it in your calendar.
Comment SPACE or 🌙 and I'll send a gentle next step for the reply you're holding.
This is for reference. For a serious question, book a personal reading through the link in bio. For entertainment and self-reflection.
Created with AI assistance.

platforms.label: TikTok
platforms.caption:

Then set a 90-minute timer, do one offline thing, and reply in three lines or less, or pick a time when you will.
Monthly readings and personal bookings are on IG, link in bio. For entertainment and self-reflection.
Created with AI assistance.

videos.title: W46 Yes or No #3: Should I say yes to that low-key invite?
videos.review_summary: 【審閱用】W46 Yes or No #3「Should I say yes to that low-key invite?」：01 夜空版 9 秒循環，YES=small joys／NO=going inward，IG 留言關鍵字 INVITE，TikTok 導 IG。

platforms.label: Instagram
platforms.caption:
That message is still sitting there. Someone asked if you want to grab coffee, take a walk, or just hang out, and you've been going back and forth about whether you have the energy for it.
Pause the Reel. Wherever it stops is today's answer.
Whichever way it lands, give it 10 minutes. If a quieter version of the plan still sounds okay, like a shorter coffee or a walk instead of dinner, say yes to that version. If even that feels heavy, send a kind decline today so it stops taking up space in your head.
Comment INVITE or ☕ and I'll send a kind way to decide on that plan.
This is for reference. For a serious question, book a personal reading through the link in bio.
For entertainment and self-reflection.

platforms.label: TikTok
platforms.caption:

More Yes or No episodes and personal readings on IG @ainsoflighttarot, link in bio. For entertainment and self-reflection.

videos.title: W46 Weekly card guidance: Your card for this week
videos.review_summary: 【審閱用】W46 每周卡牌指引重剪版（Template D，28.5 秒）：開頭第 0 幀就能讀到 hook，78 張 1909 RWS 牌硬切輪播後停在錢幣八，兩行指引放大且停留 7 秒，結尾淡回 hook 可循環；IG 留言關鍵字 CRAFT，TikTok 導 IG。

platforms.label: Instagram
platforms.caption:
Your card for this week, Nov 9-15. Pause the Reel when it feels right and read the card you land on. That is your guidance for the week.
If you landed on the Eight of Pentacles, your focus is steady progress. Choose the one task you keep pushing back and give it 20 focused minutes today. Small, repeated effort adds up faster than waiting for the perfect moment.
Save this so you can check back midweek. Comment CRAFT or 🪙 and I'll send this week's card and one small task to start today.
For reference only. If you are carrying a serious question, find the personal reading link in my bio. For entertainment and self-reflection.

platforms.label: TikTok
platforms.caption: Pause to get your card for Nov 9-15. Landed on the Eight of Pentacles? Give your most postponed task 20 focused minutes today. Save this for the week. Full weekly guidance and personal readings on IG @ainsoflighttarot, link in bio. For entertainment and self-reflection.

videos.title: Yes or No #1: Should I text first this week?
videos.review_summary: 【審閱用】第 1 集題目：這週要不要先傳訊息？開場：IG「如果有個安靜的聊天室一直在你腦子裡轉，停在這裡」，TikTok「這週該先傳嗎？覺得對了就暫停」。

platforms.label: Instagram
platforms.caption:
Should you text first this week? Pause the Reel. Wherever it stops is today's answer.

If you've been opening and closing the same quiet chat, here is one thing to try whichever way it lands. Before you type anything, write one clear sentence of what you actually want from their reply. Read it back. If it still feels true, you'll know what you're reaching out for.

Comment TEXT or 📱 and I'll send what your answer can mean for that first text.

This is for reference. For a serious question, book a personal reading via the link in bio.

For entertainment and self-reflection.

platforms.label: TikTok
platforms.caption:
Pause when it feels right. Wherever it stops is your answer for this week. Write one sentence of what you want from the reply before you text. More readings on IG @ainsoflighttarot, link in bio.

For entertainment and self-reflection.
